subject: Renewal & expansion: PO routing, net-term change and billing delegate for NovaProspect
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@novaprospect.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofie Alder <sofie.alder@novaprospect.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity add — AP questions, PO & payment lane

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re doing well — we’re moving ahead with the renewal and adding the extra 50k tokens/month (capacity addition). Finance has a couple of items before they can issue the PO:

- Can Redwood accept a single consolidated PO that covers both the renewal term and the upsell?
- Can we move to Net 60 for this renewal (we’re currently Net 30) — finance is asking for the extended term for budget reasons.
- Who should be the billing contact for invoice delivery and EFT setup?

I’ve cc’d our AP lead Sofie. If it helps, they can push the PO through once we confirm routing and the billing entity reference.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform, NovaProspect
oliver.grant@novaprospect.com

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@novaprospect.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — AP questions, PO & payment lane

Hi Oliver — great to hear this is moving forward, and congrats on the expanded usage. Quick answers below and next steps: 

1) Consolidated PO: Yes — Redwood can accept a single PO that covers both the renewal term and the upsell. We just need the PO to reference deal id NP-2028-EXP-42 and the billing entity name (see our standard payee lines below).

2) Net terms: We can accommodate Net 60 for this renewal as a one-off for NovaProspect. I’ve looped in Marissa (billing) and Vivek (account exec) to formalize that in a commitment addendum. We’ll issue an updated invoice cadence note so your AP team has the correct due dates.

3) Billing contact / EFT setup: Please route invoices to billing@novaprospect.com and send EFT details to finance.ops@novaprospect.com. On our side, Marissa will be the billing owner for the account; I’m copying her below and she’ll share the W9 and payee formatting. 

Next steps I’ll take:
- Marissa: provide payee name + W9 and draft a short amendment that documents Net 60 for this renewal and the capacity add.
- Vivek & I: confirm updated invoice schedule and any prompt-pay discount eligibility (if NovaProspect wants to keep Net 60 but use ACH/EFT we may be able to offer a 1.5% prompt-pay credit).

If you can share a draft PO file (pdf) when ready, Marissa will confirm all fields match our payee requirements.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@novaprospect.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — AP questions, PO & payment lane

Hi Oliver / team — attaching the W9 and the payee formatting guidelines that AP needs. I also prepared a short commitment addendum PDF that notes: 12-month renewal term, capacity +50k tokens/mo, Net 60 payment terms for the first invoice cycle, and reference to deal NP-2028-EXP-42.

Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Terms.docx (payee format + W9 included)

A few AP notes: 
- Please ensure the PO includes: payee name exactly "Redwood Inference, Inc.", EIN 12-3456789, billing contact: billing@novaprospect.com, remit to address in the doc.
- If you submit via ProcureNow/Ariba, send the portal confirmation to billing@redwood.ai so we can match automatically.
- For Net 60: we’ll apply Net 60 to invoices dated within the renewal period. If AP elects EFT (ACH) we can discuss a 1.5% prompt-pay credit to be applied to the next invoice if payment posts within 7 days. 

I’ll review your PO once you send it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Terms.docx

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attaching our PO (NP_PO_4208.pdf) — it references NP-2028-EXP-42 and uses the payee name provided. We’ll submit via our procurement portal later today and have Sofie confirm when it’s posted.

Attachment: NP_PO_4208.pdf

One final ask: can you confirm the invoice sequence (first invoice date) so our treasury team knows when Net 60 starts counting? We want to ensure the EFT setup aligns.

Oliver

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — AP questions, PO & payment lane

Oliver — received, thanks. Marissa: we’re good to accept NP_PO_4208.pdf as-is if PO fields match the attached docx (they do).

Confirmation for treasury: the first invoice will be generated on the renewal effective date (2028-04-05) and will include the prorated upsell quantity through the end of the billing cycle. Net 60 will be measured from the invoice date (so due date will be 2028-06-04 for that invoice). If AP elects EFT and pays within 7 days, we’ll apply the 1.5% prompt-pay credit on the following invoice as previously noted.

Marissa, can you send the DocuSign link for the addendum once you’ve uploaded it? We’ll need a signed commitment to finalize the Net 60 exception.

Thanks all — happy to hop on a 15m call if there are questions.

Best,
Rachel
